1bd8af3d7e79377532e7f37c4f9d3c3cce08430d.sourceText: **当前use_scan_matching=False、do_loop_closing=False。** 从空地图进行常规建图时，Karto仍接收扫描并形成栅格，但跳过扫描匹配，也不把新扫描加入位姿图；因此不会通过自动闭环调用Ceres修正轨迹。这里的图主要依靠上游里程计摆放扫描，长距离、转弯后的累计误差不能指望这组求解器设置自动消除。[当前处理路径（Mapper.cpp，2.6.10）](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/lib/karto_sdk/src/Mapper.cpp)
1bd8af3d7e79377532e7f37c4f9d3c3cce08430d.translatedText: **Currently use_scan_matching=False, do_loop_closing=False\.** When performing regular mapping from an empty map, Karto still receives scans and forms a grid, but skips scan matching and does not add new scans to the pose graph; therefore, it will not call Ceres through automatic loop closure to correct the trajectory\. The graph here mainly relies on upstream odometry to place scans, and accumulated errors after long distances and turns cannot be expected to be automatically eliminated by this set of solver settings\.[Current processing path (Mapper.cpp, 2\.6\.10)](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/lib/karto_sdk/src/Mapper.cpp)

1be661a2e197f16fea409f3d1ee23f2642ebe523.sourceText: 即使 CPU 只有一个核心，操作系统也可以让不同线程轮流获得执行时间，让这些任务看起来都在推进。
1be661a2e197f16fea409f3d1ee23f2642ebe523.translatedText: Even if the CPU has only one core, the operating system can allow different threads to take turns getting execution time, making these tasks appear to be progressing\.

1bffdfdae60409ddb9d6d7d9977b9cd3a3a86c4b.sourceText:
1. 进入`feeds/luci/themes/`目录
2. 找到Argon主题所在的目录（一般为`luci-theme-argon`），并进入该目录
3. 打开`root/usr/share/luci/static/resources/view/themes/argon/header.htm`文件，该文件定义了Argon主题的顶部导航栏、LOGO等内容
4. 在header.htm文件中找到需要修改的内容，并进行相应的编辑和保存。例如，将LOGO图片路径指向自己的图片文件，或者调整导航栏的布局和样式
5. 如果需要修改Argon主题的其他部分，例如底部导航栏、颜色方案等，可以在`root/usr/share/luci/static/resources/view/themes/argon/`目录下找到对应的文件进行编辑
1bffdfdae60409ddb9d6d7d9977b9cd3a3a86c4b.translatedText:
1. Enter`feeds/luci/themes/`directory
2. Locate the directory where the Argon theme is installed (usually`luci-theme-argon`), and enter that directory
3. Open the`root/usr/share/luci/static/resources/view/themes/argon/header.htm`file, which defines the Argon theme's top navigation bar, LOGO, and other content
4. Find the content to modify in the header.htm file, then edit and save it accordingly\. For example, point the LOGO image path to your own image file, or adjust the layout and style of the navigation bar
5. If you need to modify other parts of the Argon theme, such as the bottom navigation bar, color scheme, etc\., you can find and edit the corresponding files in the`root/usr/share/luci/static/resources/view/themes/argon/`directory
